items.answer: A Goal binds exact endorsed intent, beneficiary, measurable completion predicate, exclusions, responsible assignment, horizon and review date. Revisions preserve earlier meanings and reasons. A later worker loads the same original and current bindings, rather than treating a regenerated goal summary as a new authoritative objective.

items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending
items.answer: An Opportunity or proposed intent records an idea and its uncertainty. Commitment requires the legitimate endorsed decision, applicable authority and accepted responsibility; an external promise additionally records the actual agreement or other duty source. Moving a card into active work cannot invent an agreement, funds or permission to sell.

items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending
items.answer: Preserve the original instruction, return the interpreted outcome, limits and examples, and obtain exact endorsement from the applicable authority. The recipient acknowledges scope and demonstrates a consequential understanding check where required. Command acceptance is independently witnessed; receipt alone proves neither shared meaning nor business fulfillment.

items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending
items.answer: Mandate and the AuthorityMatrix identify who can endorse each direction domain, which combinations must agree, and who may propose or supply evidence. items.question: How do you know a goal is finished?
items.uncertainty: Actual owner purposes, exclusions, review horizon and exposure bounds are operating inputs; no current endorsement or useful goal persistence is established here.
items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending
items.answer: Finish a Goal only when its exact outcome predicate has current accepted EvidenceJudgment and all required child outcomes and surviving duties have a legitimate disposition. A completed report can be inconclusive without accepting its subject. Revenue, task count and a producer's completion message cannot substitute for the stated beneficiary result.
items.field_name: Direction and intent — what the company is trying to do

items.question: Who decides what matters most when two goals want the same resources?
items.uncertainty: Actual owner purposes, exclusions, review horizon and exposure bounds are operating inputs; no current endorsement or useful goal persistence is established here.
items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending
items.answer: The legitimate portfolio/domain allocator compares stage-specific benefit, deadlines, distinct resource accounts, commitments and foregone work. Its recorded decision assigns finite reservations without moving protected due-service or discovery capacity through an ordinary priority choice. Conflicting personal ends return to their actual authority, not a model score.
items.field_name: Direction and intent — what the company is trying to do

items.field_title: Direction and intent — what the company is trying to do
items.question: What happens to a goal nobody has touched in a long time?
items.uncertainty: Actual owner purposes, exclusions, review horizon and exposure bounds are operating inputs; no current endorsement or useful goal persistence is established here.
items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending
items.answer: At its declared review date the custodian examines whether the goal remains endorsed, premises are current and a useful next discriminator exists. Reaffirm, narrow, park with a trigger or abandon through the authorized route. Mere inactivity is not abandonment, and a periodic restart does not replenish its causal allowance.
items.field_name: Direction and intent — what the company is trying to do

items.question: How is a goal abandoned, and by whom?
items.uncertainty: Actual owner purposes, exclusions, review horizon and exposure bounds are operating inputs; no current endorsement or useful goal persistence is established here.
items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending
items.answer: The designated abandonment authority records why the goal stops, its remaining promises and resources, and the actual disposition owner. Stop new dependent work, reconcile released unknown effects, and transfer or perform surviving duties. Abandoning the commercial objective does not erase contracts, customer repair or data obligations.
items.field_name: Direction and intent — what the company is trying to do

items.field_title: Direction and intent — what the company is trying to do
items.question: What tells you a goal was the wrong goal rather than badly executed?
items.uncertainty: Actual owner purposes, exclusions, review horizon and exposure bounds are operating inputs; no current endorsement or useful goal persistence is established here.
items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending
items.answer: Separate execution evidence from the value proposition: did the product meet its specification, and did actual beneficiary use or a bounded experiment support the goal's premise? Record rival explanations and missing evidence. An inconclusive test triggers a discriminator or stop decision, not a fabricated verdict that the goal itself was wrong.

items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending
items.answer: Create an endorsed successor IntentVersion/Goal revision linked to the old reason, contrary evidence and change decision. Reconcile affected work, artifacts, grants and allocations while preserving sold terms and unresolved duties. Historical accounts retain what was believed at the time, rather than rewriting the original motivation.

items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending
items.answer: Plan executable detail only as far as current evidence, commitments, capacity and control support. Keep later stages as alternatives with assumptions and review triggers; each next WorkOrder has finite inputs, resources and acceptance. Unsupported lead-time bounds cannot become a service promise merely because a plan needs a date.

items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending

A parking list does not reserve unlimited resources or repeatedly restart an expired investigation; adoption later requires current evidence and allocation.

items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending

A first venture can research before any customer history exists.

items.answer_status: substantive specification authored; complete-plan independent review pending
items.answer: Deduplicate provider events by connection/account/event ID and commands by command identity. JMAP native IDs plus Message-ID/content correlation distinguish duplicate delivery from a new message; business conflict identities prevent cross-tool duplicate payment or promise even when event IDs differ. For outbound-mail provider events the identity is the closed tuple (company, connection, provider server, record_type, event_occurrence_key) of section 9.4: record_type is inside the identity so a delivery, a later bounce and a later complaint for one message stay three distinct effects, the occurrence key uses only fields whose invariance under provider redelivery was established at admission, same-identity different-content events become contested rather than dropped, and a record type with no bindable stable identity is admitted only in reconcile-only mode. A lost acknowledgement or a lost deduplication index never authorizes a resend: redelivery is deduplicated, and a lost send acknowledgement stays unknown_effect with an owned reconciliation duty.

items.answer_scope: Nine logical responsibilities retain control, information, evidence, authority and failure flows; nineteen attributes each; custom primitive and deployment costs explicit. items.title: Agent operating model
items.answer_scope: Consequence class decides who may act; a declared procedure decides how work runs and what each step may see. Five step kinds, a declared read set the loader delivers and records, guards as pure functions over typed outputs, the step boundary as the checkpoint, one effect per effect step, an attempt ceiling with a stated behaviour and no_progress as a terminal class with a named recipient. Temporary workers only: each exists against an ExistenceJustification naming one reason, its unit and a test that can return false, with specialized knowledge refused as a reason and attributable identity mandatory and never itself a reason. Admission computes the class before the kind, refusal is a terminal state with a named failed predicate and its own acceptance owner, and deterministic, workflow, model, human and professional execution are selected by the actual work, its consequence and its evidence.

items.title: Agent organization
items.answer_scope: Persistent department/persona roster still not justified, and there is now a control against one appearing: the profile-convergence probe, with the layer removed if the profile count converges to a small stable set. Versioned templates and temporary instances keep scoped creation, qualification, restriction and termination; success does not raise authority. Standing accountability is a separate layer rather than a roster: exactly one standing party for each duty that outlives the case carrying it, admitted by a three-part conjunction, holding an address and a capacity reservation, and prohibited from producing, from releasing, from deciding the matter it is the subject of and from carrying model memory. Retirement is refused while a duty it holds is live, suspension stops admission in that duty class rather than leaving work assigned and silent, and a proposed holder no frozen fixture exercises is refused on sight.

status_rule.kind: The rule that assigns every coverage-register status. Not a status itself.
status_rule.hand_edit: refused — run `node scripts/vision-coverage-registers.mjs project --write`; `verify` fails on drift
status_rule.answered_means: planning/reviews/G-acceptance-protocol.md: "'Answered' means specified at this gate; 'implemented' requires later implementation evidence."
status_rule.answer_field: Each row declares which key of its answer node carries the substantive text. The two source shapes are not unified by renaming: `decision` is the authored key of the integrations-capacity-build.json and components-authority.json question records.

rules.why: The row already carries an authored §8.24 judgement that no classifier may produce — the 35 supplemental rows superseded at 12-scope-lifecycle-traceability.md#scope-decision are the live case. Running the rules over them would have relabelled all 35 from a deliberate supersession to a computed status, which is the classifier overwriting a decision.

The row states that a qualified external human — professional, licensed practitioner, assessor, insurer — and their engagement, result, standing or fee is what remains open. The phrase must join the actor to the act; a mention of "professional/admin/owner labor" inside a cost list does not fire it.

The row states that an input only the owner can supply — endorsement, purpose, cap, mandate, account admission, real organisational standing — is not established. It is a decision, not a measurement: no test run by this system can produce it.

The row states that a quantity inside its own answer is not yet measured — a latency, a rate, a cost, an effect size — so the answer cannot be closed by specification alone. This is NOT the same as the implementation evidence every unimplemented contract owes: phrases of the form "require the stated tests" or "remains unimplemented" are deliberately not in this list, because they describe the gate ahead of the whole package rather than an unmeasured quantity in this answer.

After the package-wide gate phrases are removed (GATE_PHRASES — "remains unimplemented", "require the stated tests", "pending independent complete-plan review" and the rest), the uncertainty still names something this project must do or obtain before the answer can be relied on: a test to run, a catalog to build, an input not supplied. The answer is written; it is not yet good for use. This rule is why "Answered" is not what every row falls into: it is checked BEFORE R9, so R9 keeps only the rows whose sole open item is the gate that stands in front of the whole package.

Positive test, not a default: the answer pointer resolves, the declared answer_field holds substantive text, and the answer node names a planned verification. "Answered" is the acceptance protocol's sense — specified at this gate. The row keeps its own implementation_status ("planned-not-existing") and answer_status ("independent review pending"), which is where the fact that nothing is built or accepted is carried.
The row does not pass R9 and no rule read its text. It keeps the status the whole register carried before this repair. Nothing is guessed.

status_rule.order: first match wins, in the order listed
status_rule.cannot_produce_why: Each is an authored judgement about a specific row. A classifier that emitted one would be inventing a refusal or an acceptance nobody made. They remain available to a human author, and a row carrying one would have to leave this rule set explicitly.
status_rule.repair_state: G1-02 and G1-03 repaired, pending independent recheck
